query: INSERT INTO whatsapp_lid_mappings (account_id, lid, phone_number, learning_source, created_at, updated_at) SELECT $1, * FROM UNNEST($2::TEXT[], $3::TEXT[], $4::TEXT[], $5::BIGINT[], $6::BIGINT[]) ON CONFLICT (account_id, lid) DO UPDATE SET phone_number = EXCLUDED.phone_number, learning_source = EXCLUDED.learning_source, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
